text:
Avery_CS: ProtonHealth reserved pool go-live Tue 2026-03-31. Need final quota, autoscale, and loadtest plan.
Ravi_SRE: Understood. Expected steady 600 RPS, spikes to 1.2k for ~30s. Mostly text-gen; avg output ~1100 tokens.
Diego_SE: Recommend two-stage test: soak 2h @600RPS, spike runs 6x 30s @1.2k with 5min recovery. I can drop k6 and warmup scripts.
Avery_CS: Please do. Also need fallback model chain and confirmation of reserved vs burst quotas.
Ravi_SRE: Contracted reserve=700 tokens/s equivalent. Request temporary bump to 1.5k or enable cross-pool burst. Fallbacks: redwood-m4-q4 -> redwood-m3-q8 -> hosted-small.
Lina_Proton: Proton needs KMS-encrypted logs, KV cache seeded for top-20 prompts, and canary traffic from us-east-1.
Diego_SE: k6 script (minimal): ```js
import http from 'k6/http'
import { sleep } from 'k6'
export default function () {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt: 'TL;DR:', max_tokens: 120}))
  sleep(0.083)
}
```
Avery_CS: Ravi — autoscale target? aggressive up, gentle down. Down cooldown 10m preferred.
Ravi_SRE: Proposal: metric=token_out_per_min, scale_up_multiplier=3x within 30s, scale_down_cooldown=600s, min_instances=4, max_instances=20. Will validate in staging and post JSON.
deploy-bot: scheduled: capacity-bakeoff-reminder at 2026-03-25T20:00:00Z (runbook link) :bell: 
Diego_SE: We'll capture perf snapshot: tail 1m p50/p95/p99 + sample failed payloads. Add to ORT ticket.
Avery_CS: I'll coordinate with Proton, create runbook, and own call 09:00-23:00 UTC. Ravi to be oncall for bakeoff window.
Lina_Proton: Confirmed. Thanks team :thumbsup: 
Ravi_SRE: Posting staging artifacts EOD tomorrow.
